description: This Java source file defines the class SudoRetrieveThings, a command used internally within the Eclipse Ditto project to retrieve multiple Thing objects by their IDs without authorization. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and serializing to JSON, as well as handling command headers and fields.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveThings
classes.description: A command class used internally in Eclipse Ditto to retrieve multiple Thing objects by their IDs without authorization. It supports JSON serialization/deserialization, command header management, and equality checks.
